استشكلن (form X)
# اِسْتَشْكَلْنَ (istaškalna) /is.taʃ.kal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اُسْتُشْكِلْنَ (ustuškilna) /us.tuʃ.kil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اِسْتَشْكِلْنَ (istaškilna) /is.taʃ.kil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
